title: Synchronous asset loading on GameThread
fix_rationale: The trace shows the GameThread blocked waiting for synchronous asset loading. Replacing hard object references with soft references and asynchronous loading prevents blocking the game loop.
evidence_template: {timer} stalled the GameThread for {ms} ms (normally {baseline_ms} ms), accounting for {share}% of the hitch duration.

fixes.text: Convert hard asset pointers (UTexture2D*, TObjectPtr) to soft object references (TSoftObjectPtr, TSoftClassPtr).
Preload assets asynchronously using StreamableManager or Asset Manager during level transitions.
Inspect the Reference Viewer to find and prune unintended transitive hard dependencies.

verify: Re-trigger the gameplay event and verify that synchronous loading scopes drop to 0 ms.
caveats: Synchronous asset loading in PIE may include compiling or disk caching costs not present in cooked builds.
